about: Review N9: every request the game client sends, as it sends them. game/test/requests.test.ts fails when the client's requests change and this file isn't updated with them; tests/compat_smoke.py replays the PREVIOUS release's copy of this file against the new backend (scripts/compat-check.sh), so a backend that refuses what players' cached clients still send fails CI. Placeholders: $TOKEN (a fresh launch token), $UUID (a new id), $NEXT (the cursor from the history answer before; skipped when there is none), $NOW (the time now, in milliseconds). goesOnWithout: the game carries on whatever the answer (a report, review 7.4), so a backend without the endpoint (404, or 403 from a backend that denies paths it doesn't know) is accepted; any other refusal is not.
